sources.snippet: Zamba2 1.2B Instruct is a lightweight instruction-following model open-sourced by Zyphra with only 1.2 billion parameters, suitable for resource-constrained environments. It demonstrates stable performance in text generation and instruction following, making it an economical choice for edge computing or mobile deployment to build low-cost, high-efficiency AI applications.
